_description: River-monitoring instrument raft. A welded rectangular pontoon 3.20 m x 1.60 m on the waterline and 0.55 m deep, 1120 kg all up (structure, batteries, mast, logger, crew of one), floating in fresh water at 20 C. A 60 mm circular strut hangs a sensor pod 0.90 m down into the current, and an 8 m run of 19 mm bore plastic sampling line lifts 0.25 L/s the 0.60 m from the strut inlet to the deck tank. One object, so the hydrostatic gates and the flow gates are describing the same raft and not two unrelated fictions.

_notes.fluid_density_kg_m3: rho of the fluid the body sits in, kg/m3. 998 fresh water at 20 C, 1025 sea water.
_notes.kinematic_viscosity_m2_s: nu, m2/s. Fresh water at 20 C. Dynamic viscosity in Pa.s is accepted instead as dynamic_viscosity_pa_s and divided by rho.
_notes.mass_total_kg: Everything that goes in the water: structure, payload, ballast, batteries, crew. kg.
_notes.waterline_length_m: LWL, m. Documentation only - no gate reads it; it is what waterplane_area_m2 and waterplane_inertia_m4 were computed from.
_notes.waterline_beam_m: BWL, m. Sets the pack's default margins: min GM is 5% of it, min GZ 1% of it.
_notes.hull_depth_m: Bottom (keel datum) to deck edge, m. Freeboard is this minus the draft, so it must use the same datum as kg_m and kb_m.
_notes.waterplane_area_m2: Awp at the loaded waterline, m2. Here 3.20 x 1.60. Draft is displaced volume over this (wall-sided, exact for a box).
_notes.hull_volume_m3: Watertight displaceable volume, m3. Here 5.12 x 0.55. Buoyancy asks what fraction of it flotation already consumes.
_notes.waterplane_inertia_m4: Transverse second moment of the waterplane about the centreline, m4. L.B^3/12 = 1.0923 for this rectangle. Stated rather than left to the pack's rectangular fallback, which is optimistic for any finer shape.
_notes.kb_m: Centre of buoyancy above the keel datum, m. Draft/2 for a box section: 0.2192/2.
_notes.kg_m: Vertical centre of gravity above the same keel datum, m. 0.42 with the batteries low and the mast light. GM = BM - (KG - KB).
_notes.heel_angle_deg: Design heel the righting arm is evaluated at, deg. Must be at or under 10: GZ = GM.sin(theta) is void past that and the gate skips rather than answer.
_notes.heeling_moment_nm: Upsetting moment the hull must stand up to, N.m. 600 N.m is the crew plus gear on one gunwale; it sets the minimum righting arm as moment/weight.
_notes.flow_velocity_m_s: Free-stream current past the sensor strut, m/s. EXTERNAL flow only - it is never read as the bulk velocity in the sampling line, which must come from flow_rate_m3_s or pipe_velocity_m_s.
_notes.drag_shape_class: Key into the pack's Cd table, each entry carrying the Reynolds band it was measured over. cylinder_cross is Cd 1.20, valid Re 1e4-2e5.
_notes.diameter_m: Strut diameter, m. Doubles as the characteristic length for the external Reynolds number: Re = v.D/nu = 3.3e4, inside the cylinder band.
_notes.frontal_area_m2: Reference area the Cd is defined against, m2. Frontal for every entry in this pack's table: 0.060 m x 0.90 m of immersed strut.
_notes.max_drag_force_n: Drag the mooring and the strut root are designed to carry, N. The acceptance side of the drag gate; without it a force is a measurement that settles nothing.
_notes.pipe_diameter_m: INTERNAL bore of the sampling line, m. Nominal pipe size is not a bore.
_notes.pipe_length_m: Developed run length, m, strut inlet to deck tank.
_notes.pipe_roughness_m: Absolute roughness epsilon, m - not mm. 1.5e-6 drawn plastic, 4.5e-5 commercial steel.
_notes.flow_rate_m3_s: Volumetric flow Q, m3/s. 2.5e-4 is 0.25 L/s; bulk velocity is Q/A = 0.88 m/s, internal Re 1.7e4, firmly turbulent.
_notes.minor_loss_k_total: Sum of K for fittings, dimensionless: strainer, two elbows, a valve, entry and exit. Omitting it is a silent zero worth 1.6 kPa here.
_notes.available_head_m: Head the pump SUPPLIES at this flow, m. Static lift comes out of it first and the remainder is the friction budget: rho.g.(2.5 - 0.60) = 18.6 kPa, against 6.0 kPa of computed loss.
_notes.static_lift_m: Elevation the sample is lifted, m, strut inlet to the deck tank surface. A DEMAND on head, subtracted from available_head_m - not a supply. Positive lifts; a negative value would be a downhill run.
_notes.max_volume_fraction: Most of the watertight volume flotation may consume at rest, 0-1. 0.90 leaves a tenth as reserve buoyancy. A volume fraction, not a draft fraction.
_notes.min_freeboard_m: Minimum deck edge above the loaded waterline, m. Stated absolutely here rather than left to the pack default of 15% of depth.
_notes.min_gm_m: Minimum initial metacentric height, m. 0.35 is a working figure for a crewed instrument raft; the pack default would be 5% of beam = 0.08, which is a sign check more than a margin.
